quote: dbt Charts compiles YAML boards into dashboards. This repo takes no contributions; use it as a package.
statement: In this repository, contributors must not submit code changes; the repo is consumed as a package only.

quote: Not accepted. Changes pushed to this repository cannot reach the upstream, so any pull request opened here will be closed unmerged.
statement: In this repository, pull requests are not accepted; changes must go through the private upstream.
In all Python files, code must not violate ruff pycodestyle error rules (E family).
In all Python files, code must not violate ruff pycodestyle warning rules (W family).
In all Python files, code must not violate Pyflakes rules (F family: unused imports/variables, undefined names, etc.).
In all Python files, imports must be sorted per ruff isort rules (I family).
In all Python files, code must not violate flake8-bugbear rules (B family).
In all Python files, code must follow flake8-comprehensions rules (C4 family: no unnecessary list/dict/set calls or comprehensions).

In all Python files, code must follow flake8-simplify rules (SIM family).
In all Python files, code must not use try/except with a bare `pass` body (S110).

quote: "BLE001",  # flake8-blind-except: catch broad Exception/BaseException without re-raising
statement: In all Python files, code must not catch broad Exception/BaseException without re-raising (BLE001).
In all Python files, code must not raise the vanilla Exception class directly; raise a specific/custom exception (TRY002).
In test files, pytest code must follow flake8-pytest-style rules (PT family).
In shipped Python source, every function parameter must have a type annotation (ANN001).
In shipped Python source, every public function must declare a return type annotation (ANN201).
In shipped Python source, every private function must declare a return type annotation (ANN202).
In shipped Python source, *args parameters must have a type annotation (ANN002).
In shipped Python source, **kwargs parameters must have a type annotation (ANN003).
In shipped Python source, special methods (__init__ etc.) must declare a return type annotation (ANN204).

quote: ignore = ["E501"]  # line too long (the formatter handles this)

In all Python files, assigning a lambda to a name is allowed (E731 disabled).

quote: "E402",  # module import not at top (needed for conditional imports, circular import avoidance)
statement: In all Python files, module-level imports not at the top of the file are allowed (E402 disabled).

quote: "B008",  # function call in default argument (FastAPI pattern: Body(), Query(), Depends())
statement: In all Python files, function calls in default arguments (e.g. FastAPI Body()/Query()/Depends()) are allowed (B008 disabled).

quote: "SIM102",  # collapsible if (nested ifs often more readable for complex conditions)
statement: In all Python files, nested ifs that could be collapsed are allowed (SIM102 disabled).

quote: "PT018",  # composite-assertion: stylistic; splitting `assert a and b` rarely improves diagnostics
statement: In tests, composite assertions like `assert a and b` are allowed (PT018 disabled).
In all Python files, code must use pathlib instead of os.path / open() style path functions (PTH family).
In all Python files, open() / Path.read_text() / Path.write_text() calls must pass an explicit encoding= argument (PLW1514, preview).
In vulture-whitelist.py, useless expressions (B018) and undefined names (F821) are allowed.

statement: In libs/markdown-svg, non-lowercase function names (e.g. HTTP handler do_GET) are allowed (N802 disabled).

scope: src/**, tests/**, scripts/**, libs/markdown-svg/**, libs/d3-format/** (minus excluded tests/core subtrees)

statement: In pyright-checked code, importing private (non-re-exported) symbols from packages is not reported (reportPrivateImportUsage off).
In pyright-checked code, unresolvable imports should be avoided (reportMissingImports downgraded to warning for the optional dbt_charts_super_schema).
In pyright-checked code, subclasses should not override class variables with incompatible types (warning).
In pyright-checked code, cast() calls must not be unnecessary (cast to the already-known type).
In pyright-checked code, unhashable values must not be used as dict keys or set members.
In pyright-checked code, deprecated APIs and typing constructs must not be used.
In pyright-checked code, ALL_CAPS constants must not be reassigned.
In pyright-checked code, imports must not be unused.
In pyright-checked code, comparisons that are always true/false by type must not appear.
In pyright-checked code, isinstance() checks that are always true by type must not appear.
In pyright-checked code, private functions must not be left unused.
In pyright-checked code, local variables must not be left unused.
In pyright-checked code, call arguments must match parameter types.
In pyright-checked code, match statements must be exhaustive.
In pyright-checked code, unreachable code must not appear.
In pyright-checked code, variables must not be possibly unbound at use.
In pyright-checked code, `# type: ignore` comments must not be unnecessary.
In pyright-checked code, assert_type() calls must match the inferred type.
In pyright-checked code, _private members of other modules/classes should not be accessed (warning).
In pyright-checked code, imported third-party packages must have type stubs (or be typed).
In pyright-checked code, lambda parameters/returns must not have unknown types.
In pyright-checked code, generic classes must be given explicit type arguments (e.g. list[str], not bare list).
In src/dbt_charts/core/inspect/resolver.py, argument-type mismatches are downgraded to warnings.
In src, tests and scripts, code must not contain dead (unused) code detected by vulture at >=80% confidence; Typer command and MCP server handler decorators are exempt.

quote: importlib mode: dbt-charts/tests/ has no __init__.py (AGENTS.md forbids adding one)
statement: In tests/, no directory may contain an __init__.py file.
In src/dbt_charts, lower layers must not import higher ones: core must not import agent_api or surface (ai), and agent_api must not import surface.
In src and tests, tach modules must not have circular dependencies.

quote: Class A (wheel-outbound bans) — enforced by `tach check-external` as an allowlist: only deps declared in dbt-charts/pyproject.toml [project] dependencies plus the `external.exclude` carve-outs below may be imported.
statement: In src and tests, code may import only third-party packages declared in pyproject.toml [project] dependencies or listed in tach.toml external.exclude.

quote: Django is barred by `check-external`: it is not a declared dependency of this wheel, so an import of it anywhere in src/ fails the allowlist.
statement: In src/, code must not import django.

In dbt_charts.core (blanket module), code may import only the listed core submodules (attribution, aliases, colors, column_types, diagnostics, compile, dbt_manifest, font_measure, fonts, links, numeric, constants, utils, text, dialects).

quote: path = "dbt_charts.core.diagnostics" depends_on = []   # leaf node — pins compile/execute/render ↛ diagnostics invariant
statement: In dbt_charts.core.diagnostics, code must not import any other first-party module (leaf node).
In dbt_charts.core.aliases, code must not import any other first-party module (leaf node; hosts must not import serve/ to get alias normalization).
In dbt_charts.core.colors, code may import only dbt_charts.core.diagnostics among first-party modules.
In dbt_charts.core.column_types, code may import only dbt_charts.core.diagnostics among first-party modules.
In dbt_charts.core.links, code must not import any other first-party module (leaf node).
In dbt_charts.core.attribution, code must not import any other first-party module (leaf node).

quote: path = "dbt_charts.core.fonts" depends_on = []   # leaf node — shared vendored-font asset lookup
statement: In dbt_charts.core.fonts, code must not import any other first-party module (leaf node).
In dbt_charts.core.font_measure, code may import only dbt_charts.core.fonts among first-party modules.
In dbt_charts.core.text, code may import only dbt_charts.core.utils and dbt_charts.core.numeric among first-party modules (no compile/render/execute).

quote: path = "dbt_charts.core.utils" depends_on = ["dbt_charts.core.font_measure"]   # leaf-of-leaves ... no compile/render/execute deps
statement: In dbt_charts.core.utils, code may import only dbt_charts.core.font_measure among first-party modules.

quote: path = "dbt_charts.core.dialects" depends_on = []   # leaf node — no compile/execute/render deps
statement: In dbt_charts.core.dialects, code must not import any other first-party module (leaf node).

quote: path = "dbt_charts.core.constants" # Leaf node: non-authorable engine constants, plain typed values only. depends_on = []
statement: In dbt_charts.core.constants, code must not import any other first-party module and must hold only plain typed constant values.
In dbt_charts.core.numeric, code must not import any other first-party module (leaf node, zero dbt charts-specific types).
In dbt_charts.core.dbt_manifest, code may import only dbt_charts.core.diagnostics among first-party modules.

quote: The dbt.contracts import is function-local so dbt_manifest.py itself has no heavy top-level imports, keeping the leaf character.
statement: In src/dbt_charts/core/dbt_manifest.py, dbt.contracts must be imported inside functions, not at module top level.
In dbt_charts.core.compile, code may import only the listed leaf core modules and must not import render/ or execute/ (remaining exceptions carry inline tach-ignore).

quote: Each site carries an inline `# tach-ignore(...)` with its own rationale rather than a depends_on entry
statement: In src/dbt_charts, every accepted boundary-violating import must carry an inline `# tach-ignore(...)` comment with its own rationale.
In dbt_charts.agent_api, code must not import dbt_charts.cli or dbt_charts.cli.filesystem_project at runtime; FilesystemProject may be referenced only under TYPE_CHECKING.

quote: # cli routes through agent_api, never core directly (root AGENTS.md #8). path = "dbt_charts.cli" depends_on = ["dbt_charts.agent_api", "dbt_charts.cli.filesystem_project", "dbt_charts.cloud_client", "dbt_charts.telemetry"]
statement: In dbt_charts.cli, code must route through dbt_charts.agent_api and must not import dbt_charts.core (or dbt_charts.ai) directly; allowed first-party deps are agent_api, cli.filesystem_project, cloud_client, telemetry.
In dbt_charts.cloud_client, code must not import any other first-party module (not core, not agent_api).

quote: # Anonymous usage telemetry: imported only by dbt_charts.cli. ... path = "dbt_charts.telemetry" depends_on = []
statement: In dbt_charts.telemetry, code must not import any other first-party module, and only dbt_charts.cli may import telemetry.
FilesystemProject must be defined in dbt_charts.cli.filesystem_project and constructed only at the CLI composition root; that module may import only dbt_charts.core and dbt_charts.core.compile.
In dbt_charts.agent_api.project_session, tach boundary checks are turned off (unchecked).
In dbt_charts.ai, code must not import dbt_charts.cli or dbt_charts.cli.filesystem_project; it consumes an injected Project rather than constructing FilesystemProject.

quote: path = "dbt_charts.ai.tools" cannot_depend_on = ["dbt_charts.ai.mcp"]   # tools own canonical impls; mcp wraps tools
statement: In dbt_charts.ai.tools, code must not import dbt_charts.ai.mcp; mcp wraps tools, not the reverse.

In shipped wheel content, references to the internal planning doc `decisions.md` must not appear.
In shipped wheel content, references to the internal planning doc `spec.md` must not appear.
In shipped wheel content, references to the internal planning doc `design.md` must not appear.
In src/dbt_charts/core/inspect, the proprietary profiler modules (inspector.py, sources/super_schema.py, storage.py, semantic_detector.py, etc.) must not exist in the OSS package.

In shipped wheel code, imports of undeclared optional packages are allowed only for dbt_charts_super_schema, google, databricks, psycopg2, redshift_connector, snowflake, numpy, openai and metricflow_sql, and these must be lazy/gated imports.
Wheel content must come only from src/dbt_charts, libs/markdown-svg/src/mdsvg and libs/d3-format/src/d3_format.

quote: Rule 1 — No bare-dict model_config. model_config = {"extra": "forbid"} → BANNED. model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid") → OK.
statement: In src/dbt_charts/core/compile/models, model_config must be assigned a ConfigDict(...) call, never a bare dict literal.

quote: Rule 2 — Direct BaseModel subclasses must declare model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid").
statement: In src/dbt_charts/core/compile/models, every class that directly subclasses BaseModel (not enums or dataclasses) must declare model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid").

quote: Rule 3 — No new "Compiled"-prefixed class names. ADR-001: the compiled stage owns the bare name (Board, Chart, Style …).
statement: In src/dbt_charts/core/compile/models, class names must not start with `Compiled`; the compiled stage uses the bare name (Board, Chart, Style).

quote: Rule 4 — No "_types"-suffixed module filenames. Convention: {authored.py, theme.py, normalized.py, resolved.py} per subdirectory.
statement: In src/dbt_charts/core/compile/models, module filenames must not end in `_types`; use authored.py / theme.py / normalized.py / resolved.py per subdirectory.

quote: Rule 5 — Every T | None = None field in a compiled model must have a justification comment on the same line or the immediately preceding line.
statement: In theme-stage models (compile/models/style/theme/, compile/models/config.py, compile/models/chart/normalized/), every `T | None = None` field must carry a `#` justification comment on the same or preceding line.

In src/dbt_charts/core, added or modified lines must not introduce silent fallbacks (`x or <literal>`, `d.get(k, default)`, 3-arg `getattr(o, a, default)`) unless marked `# type-state: silent_fallback — <reason>`.
In src/dbt_charts/core, added or modified lines must not call cast(...) unless marked `# type-state: cast — <reason>`.
In src/dbt_charts/core, added or modified lines must not carry `# type: ignore` comments unless marked `# type-state: type_ignore — <reason>`.
In src/dbt_charts/core, added or modified lines must not use `object` as a type annotation (parameter, return or variable) unless marked `# type-state: object_annotation — <reason>`.
In src/dbt_charts/core, added or modified lines must not reference `Any` (typing.Any) unless marked `# type-state: explicit_any — <reason>`.

quote: ``optional`` is report-only: `T | None` is a contract in this repo, not rot on its own.
statement: In src/dbt_charts/core, new `Optional[...]` / `T | None` annotations should be avoided where a value is required (report-only, not blocking).
In src/dbt_charts/core, type-state exception markers must be written exactly `# type-state: <category> — <reason>` with a known category, an em-dash separator and a non-empty reason.

quote: a marker is a reviewed, reasoned exception (grammar matches this repo's ``# noqa: BLE001 — <reason>`` convention)
statement: In Python source, lint suppressions such as `# noqa: BLE001` must be followed by an em-dash and a reason (`# noqa: BLE001 — <reason>`).

quote: the root AGENTS.md "never use em or en dashes" instruction makes a hyphen the default guess
statement: In authored text, em or en dashes must not be used (root AGENTS.md instruction, exported copy omits it).

quote: Guard: no hand-authored HTML document/chrome markup in Python source files.
statement: In src/dbt_charts/core, Python string literals must not contain hand-authored HTML document/chrome tags (div, span, body, button, table, etc.); SVG geometry tags are allowed and exceptions are allowlisted with a WHY comment.

quote: No ``Resolved*`` instance may be passed to ``dataclasses.replace()`` or ``.model_copy(update=...)`` anywhere under ``dbt-charts/src``
statement: In src/, values typed as Resolved* must not be passed to dataclasses.replace() or .model_copy(update=...); Resolved* instances are final and read-only.

quote: Shipped source and tests must not cite internal decision labels.
statement: In src/dbt_charts and tests (.py/.yaml/.yml/.md), text must not cite internal decision labels such as `ADR-NNN`, `spec §` or `§N` (frozen data/schemas snapshots exempt).

quote: External callers must reach package-source assets through :data:`dbt-charts.tests._paths.DBT_CHARTS_PKG_DIR` (tests, scripts) or a public ``dbt_charts.core.<asset>`` accessor (production code).
statement: In tests/, code must not contain literal path strings like "dbt_charts/core/", "dbt_charts/cli/", "dbt_charts/ai/"; reach package assets via tests/_paths.DBT_CHARTS_PKG_DIR or a public dbt_charts.core accessor.
In src/dbt_charts/core, modules must not define module-global mutable containers (dict/list/set) named like _*cache*/_*registry*/_*sources*/_*context* unless allowlisted in the guard test.

quote: No ``.py`` under ``dbt-charts/`` imports a top-level ``tests``, ``scripts``, or ``evals`` module.
statement: In this package, Python files must not import a top-level `tests`, `scripts` or `evals` module.

quote: Vocabulary guard: reject stale 'catalog' terminology in agent-facing surfaces.
statement: In agent-facing surfaces (agent_api, cli, inspect, ai Python and SKILL.md files), the term 'catalog' must not be used except allowlisted external names (pg_catalog, catalog.json, Unity Catalog, ERR-CATALOG...).

quote: Rendering a board never fetches a remote image over the network.
statement: In render code, markdown images must never be fetched over the network (no urllib.request.urlopen of author URLs); only data: URIs are measured.

quote: `ERR-{DESCRIPTION}` for an `ErrorCode`, `WARN-{DESCRIPTION}` for a `WarningCode` — both all caps, hyphen-separated, no domain segment in the string.
statement: In src/dbt_charts/core/diagnostics/codes_*.py, ErrorCode codes must be `ERR-{DESCRIPTION}` and WarningCode codes `WARN-{DESCRIPTION}`, all caps, hyphen-separated, with no domain segment.

quote: `DESCRIPTION` names the specific failure or condition, not the fix (`KPI-MULTIROW`, not `FIX-YOUR-QUERY`).
statement: In diagnostics codes_*.py, the DESCRIPTION part of a code must name the failure/condition, not the fix.

quote: two codes that would only differ by domain are the same failure and must merge into one code, not grow a domain-qualified pair.
statement: In diagnostics codes_*.py, two codes that differ only by domain must be merged into one code.

quote: State what failed or was detected, with the concrete values substituted via `{field!r}` / `{field}` placeholders — never a generic "something went wrong" or "found an issue".
statement: In diagnostics codes_*.py, message_template must state what failed with concrete values via {field!r}/{field} placeholders and must never be a generic message like "something went wrong".

quote: Say what to do next in the same message when the fix is a single obvious action ("Use a query that returns a single row"). Reserve `hint_generator` for fixes that need computed context
statement: In diagnostics codes_*.py, a single obvious fix should be stated inside message_template; hint_generator is reserved for fixes needing computed context.

quote: No raw `\n` inside a template meant to render on one line
statement: In diagnostics codes_*.py, message_template strings must not contain raw `\n` unless the template is documented as intentionally multiline.

quote: Placeholders are named after the raise/emit site's actual variables — don't invent a placeholder the call site doesn't pass
statement: In diagnostics codes, template placeholders must match the variables the raise/emit site actually passes.

quote: Required on every `WarningCode` — constructing a `WarningCode` with it unset is a type error (`WarningCode.fix_template: str`, not `str | None`)
statement: In diagnostics codes_*.py, every WarningCode must set fix_template.

quote: `ErrorCode.fix_template` is usually left `None` ... only set it on an `ErrorCode` when the fix text is long enough or reusable enough to warrant its own field, and don't duplicate the same fix text in both `message_template` and `fix_template`.
statement: In diagnostics codes_*.py, ErrorCode.fix_template should usually be None, and fix text must not be duplicated in both message_template and fix_template.

quote: A hint that's always the same static string belongs in `message_template` (errors) or `fix_template` (warnings) instead — don't wrap a literal in a `lambda **_: "..."`.
statement: In diagnostics codes_*.py, hint_generator must only be used for computed context (e.g. suggest_close_source); it must not be a lambda returning a static string literal.

quote: Required on every code (validated by `test_registry.py`'s coverage check). ... Use the H2's slug (e.g. `charts`, `queries`) — not a hand-invented dotted namespace.
statement: In diagnostics codes_*.py, every code must set docs_topic to a reference-page H2 slug (e.g. `charts`, `queries`), not a dotted namespace.

quote: Lead with what failed or what was detected, not with an apology or hedge.
statement: In diagnostics message templates, text should lead with what failed/was detected, not an apology or hedge.

quote: the diagnostic object already carries `range` (errors) or `chart`, `field` (warnings); don't repeat them prose-style in the template if the structured fields already say it.
statement: In diagnostics message templates, file/range/chart/field already carried as structured fields should not be repeated prose-style.

quote: No silent fixes. ... the template explains why and how to fix the YAML — it must never describe the engine silently working around bad input, because it doesn't.
statement: In diagnostics templates and the engine, bad input must produce an error or warning, never a silent workaround; templates must not describe the engine working around bad input.

quote: Register it in the domain's `codes_*.py` via `REGISTRY.register(ErrorCode(...))` or `REGISTRY.register(WarningCode(...))`.
statement: New diagnostic codes must be registered in the matching domain file codes_{compile,render,execute,serve,query}.py via REGISTRY.register(ErrorCode(...)) or REGISTRY.register(WarningCode(...)).

quote: Import it in `diagnostics/__init__.py` if any other module needs the constant
statement: Diagnostic code constants used by other modules should be imported/re-exported from dbt_charts/core/diagnostics/__init__.py.

quote: For a `compile`- or `render`-domain code, regenerate the Rust code tables ... `test_generated_codes_are_up_to_date` ... fails while `libs/chart-svg/diagnostic/src/codes.rs` and `libs/chart-svg/compile/src/codes.rs` are stale.
statement: Generated Rust code tables (libs/chart-svg/*/src/codes.rs) must match the Python compile/render diagnostic registry and must not be hand-edited.

quote: ## Select figure style by family, never by OpenType feature
statement: In theme/render code, figure style (oldstyle/tabular) must be selected by naming the font family (e.g. `dbt Serif Oldstyle Tabular`), never via font-feature-settings or font-variant-numeric.

quote: the covered set is closed (currently 500 and 600 across all three variable families) and is meant to stay that way; a new weight needs a new static face, not a broader fallback.
statement: Every (vendored family, weight) cascaded by a built-in theme must have a row in fonts.WEIGHT_FACE_ALIASES mapping to a static face; a new weight requires a new static face, not a broader fallback.

quote: `_font_face.css` is written by `just gen-font-face-css` from `FONT_REGISTRY`; edit the registry, not the file.
statement: src/dbt_charts/core/render/fonts/_font_face.css is generated from FONT_REGISTRY and must not be hand-edited.

quote: It also cannot hold explanatory comments of any kind.
statement: src/dbt_charts/core/render/fonts/_font_face.css must not contain any comments (neither /* */ nor Jinja {# #}); exported SVG must not contain CSS comments.
enforced_by: test forbidding CSS comments in exported SVG

quote: Don't test or document composition against a VS16 spelling, or against a sequence this font doesn't carry both halves of.
statement: In font/emoji tests, composition must not be tested against a VS16 (U+FE0F) spelling or a sequence the vendored emoji font does not fully carry.

quote: A new family name sharing a string prefix with an already-registered family is not safe by default — verify it, don't assume it.
statement: New weight-face family names must not share a prefix with `Source Serif 4` and must be verified empirically by PNG byte diff.

quote: `dct skills chart|styling|theme` print pages that are rendered from the engine, not written by hand.
statement: src/dbt_charts/ai/skills/<name>/SKILL.md pages for chart/styling/theme are generated by scripts/gen_skill_pages.py and must not be hand-edited.

quote: `allowlist.yml`: names only. ... It carries no description, type, default or value
statement: scripts/skill_pages/allowlist.yml must contain names only, with no descriptions, types, defaults or values.

quote: A first sentence over 12 words is cut at its first `;` or `:`, and generation fails if that is still too long: shorten the description in the model
statement: In pydantic models surfaced on skill pages, a field description's first sentence must be at most 12 words (or 12 words before its first `;`/`:`).

quote: `<name>.md.j2`: hand-written text only: the frontmatter, the orientation paragraph, the Finish loop, a few one-line rules that no model, CLI or registry states, and the section order.
statement: Skill page templates (scripts/skill_pages/*.md.j2) must hold only hand-written text not stated by any model, CLI or registry.

quote: `TableInspection.to_dict()` (snake_case, file/CLI) and `TableInspection.to_json_dict()` (camelCase, JSON API / extension panels)
statement: In TableInspection, to_dict() must emit snake_case keys and to_json_dict() must emit camelCase keys.

quote: Removing or renaming required keys: bump `PROFILER_CONTRACT_VERSION` major. Changing value types of existing keys: bump `PROFILER_CONTRACT_VERSION` major. Adding new required keys: bump `PROFILER_CONTRACT_VERSION` minor.
statement: When profiler response keys change, PROFILER_CONTRACT_VERSION must be bumped (major for removing/renaming/retyping required keys, minor for adding required keys).
In the repository, file names must not conflict by case and must not use names illegal on Windows.
